approvers: Nobody else; my site manager would have to agree it works
reason: I pay about 12 a square metre today with my own lads and it works. This is around 19, so more than half again, and I still carry the risk if it marks a frame. I'm not changing something that works for that.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, so it ends up on me with the client at handover.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and sheet with tape, applied and removed by my own labour.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee from ACHV or an insurer that they pay for any damage to frames or glass from the coating or its removal, plus a price near 12 to 13 all-in and a local contractor I know who has used it.
